note: Nielsen's critique: the cut-off thesis makes every form of life, Christianity and Hinduism alike, immune to reasonable criticism and defence, which he takes to collapse into relativism. Recorded as an objection for the whole-worldview comparison: judging a consequence unacceptable does not establish falsity (#1007), and no contradiction with an established floor item is derived. Its logical residue is the self-application noted in docs/wittgenstein.md (the fideist thesis is itself a claim about the grammar of religion made outside it).
